title: Acceptance criterion verify-001-harness-list cannot pass
description:
FEATURE-VERIFY-001.md [verify-001-harness-list]: invokes staged asset sources/run_conformance.py without JQ, which that asset declares required; supply it as env={**os.environ, 'JQ': ...}

The staged asset exits on its own usage code when the variable is absent, so this criterion is false under every implementation. Supply the variable in the Blueprint specification, or answer that the story is acceptable without the criterion. Never repair it by editing the staged asset: it is restored before grading and the edit is reported as tampering.
